services.name: San Juan Cruises
services.desc: Enjoy a narrated tour to the picturesque island town of Friday Harbor! Seven days a week we’ll depart the historic Fairhaven District in Bellingham and wind our way through the heart of the San Juan Islands, with a chance of seeing wildlife along the way. Our two-hour journey through the islands is the most scenic way to get to Friday Harbor, the center of activity in the San Juans. Once there, you’ll have three hours to enjoy lunch, do some shopping, and explore this quaint seaside village. Afterwards we’ll bring you back to Bellingham on a relaxing two-hour trip back through the islands - on board you’ll enjoy the view, and perhaps enjoy a selection from our bar of Northwest beers, wines,

services.name: Gray Whale
services.desc: The Salish Sea is home to various whale species, including Bigg’s (Transient) Killer Whales, Southern Resident Orca Whales, Minke Whales, Humpback Whales, Gray Whales, and Dall’s Porpoises. Bigg’s Killer Whales, known for their hunting of seals and sea lions, and the Southern Resident Orcas, with their unique matriarchal societies and diet of salmon and other fish, are particularly notable. Other species like the Minke, Humpback, and Gray Whales are recognized for their impressive sizes and behaviors, contributing to the area’s rich biodiversity and making it a prime location for whale watching. blurb: San Juan Cruises offers a variety of water excursions including whale watching, crab dinner cruises, beer & wine tasting cruises, picnics on Sucia Island, and private charters. Their tours explore the San Juan Archipelago with over 400 islands and 478 miles of shoreline. They provide guided tours for wildlife viewing and private parties, operating since 1987.
